decisions.subject: Pipeline
decisions.reason: User footage + designed text/FX overlays, no generation.

options_considered.note: React + OffthreadVideo: frame-exact video trims/speed, spring stamp/pop motion, renderStill for the cover from the same code.

options_considered.rejected_because: Equally capable for kinetic type, but Remotion reuses the installed composer + same code path for cover still; user can switch on request.
drawtext cannot do the stamp/spring/sparkle motion design at this quality.

decisions.subject: Authoring mode
decisions.reason: Single hero promo; bespoke cream/nude/champagne-gold look.
